p: The React components powering Hanzo apps

Dialog and DropdownMenu are real components, because they carry focus management, keyboard behaviour and placement that CSS cannot. Buttons, panels, fields and tables are classes over tokens — which is why reading the markup is still possible.
WAI-ARIA compliant, keyboard navigable, screen reader tested. Accessibility isn't an afterthought — it's the foundation.

Every value comes from a @hanzo/design token — a plain CSS variable, alongside self-hosted faces. Nothing hard-codes a colour, a size or a radius, so retuning the tokens retunes everything at once and a brand fork costs nothing.
pnpm add @hanzo/ui. The same components run chat, console, and cloud — upgrade once and all three move together.
Built on @hanzo/gui primitives. No styled-components, no emotion, no CSS-in-JS at render — one atomic stylesheet, generated at build.
Powers chat.hanzo.ai, platform.hanzo.ai, and every Hanzo dashboard. If it ships in our products, it ships in your code.
